name: ais-vision-systems_post-rev360-cables_en_2026-10-29
copy: The AIS REV 360 Cables inspects the whole surface of cables and tubes up to 80 mm across at speeds of up to 300 m/min, with colour cameras and lighting built for the surface. When it finds a defect, it raises an alarm and names the type. Here it is on an extrusion line. Send us samples
